document_title: Search for work items using the text field
content:
- Word stemming applies to all Jira fields (as well as text fields).
- When Jira indexes its fields, any words that are stemmed are stored in the Jira search index in root form only.
Stemming modes
For the English language, you can choose the stemming mode by changing the Indexing Language under Settings > System > General Configuration. There are three modes available:
- English - Aggressive Stemming
- English - Moderate Stemming
- English - Minimal Stemming
The difference between them is how each word in your Jira work item is saved in the database, or tokenized. We recommend that you use the moderate or minimal stemming modes. If you enable aggressive stemming, text searches with special characters like /,@, _, ^etc. inside the search word (for example summary ~ "atlassian_jira”) will be tokenized very aggressively. As a result, fewer search results will be returned and the search experience of your users will suffer.
